title: PySpark Caching on Azure Databricks: cache() vs persist() vs checkpoint(), the Disk Cache, and When Caching Hurts
author: Karan P
brief: "Should I cache this DataFrame?" is one of those questions that sounds simple in an interview and...
fact: Lakehouse vs Warehouse in Fabric: Lakehouse is Spark-first (notebooks, files + tables, read-only SQL endpoint); Warehouse is T-SQL-first with full DML and multi-table transactions.
